dimensions.description: Checks the catalogue and does not create a new pack when project instructions or an existing pack suffice.
Defines identity, dimensions, production effects, precedence, integration, evals and example.
Turns medium/genre/style into actionable production behaviour rather than labels.
The pack is independently installable and does not depend on repository-level private references.
Includes a realistic README example with an exact copyable generation prompt.
Covers normal, draft, refinement, final and boundary behaviour.
Specific voices require authorised references; otherwise provide casting/performance guidance.
Does not expand Narrative into downstream visual/audio/game implementation.
